description:
The distiller (`tools/distill-telemetry.exs`) reports most-re-run jobs and
their wake causes, but not the proportionality census every child of this
epic is accepted against: per job kind, runs vs distinct subjects, excess,
and the wake cause of each re-run grouped by (kind, changed fact, completing
job). This was computed by hand with a throwaway script during diagnosis.

Add it as a distiller section so acceptance is one command, and so a re-run's
cause is read from telemetry, not inferred. If a re-run has no recorded wake
(a work start from blocked-waiter expansion or the activation frontier), the
section says which start reason it was — the PullSession finish event already
counts work_starts_changed_revision_wake / blocked_waiter_expansion /
activation_frontier.

Test: the distiller on a checked-in small trace yields the expected table.
Docs: `.agent/strategies/profile-a-compilation.md` gains the section.
title: The distiller reports runs vs subjects and the cause of every re-run
